message.subject: Slice 13 exact-SHA verification recorded
message.body: Verified target SHA and clean preflight, ran the 289-case controls successfully, and preserved their receipt with exact timestamps, hashes, IDs, versions, coverage, and source fingerprints. The first genuine Cooking gate cooking-et-level-runtime failed CLI 1 at its ET relation analyzer build with MSB4057; its three downstream leaves were NotRun and cooking-kitchen-loop was intentionally not launched under the stop-after-failure rule. Wrote the owned report at .trellis/tasks/10-06-cooking-issue6-truthful-gates/research/slice13-exact-sha-verification-report.md; git diff --check passed and only that report is modified, while the genuine gate result remains failed and Issue acceptance is not established.
